_documentation: Per-tier and per-team spending caps, in whole currency units. Loaded into the KVM key 'budgets'. The gateway converts these to integer micro-units internally; you never write micro-units here. A caller whose tier claim matches nothing in 'tiers' is demoted to 'defaultTier' from runtime-config.json, never promoted. See docs/07-configuration.md.

unmetered._note: Not actually unmetered - there is no such thing here. The counter still runs and still records spend; the ceiling is simply set high enough that normal interactive use will not reach it. A genuinely absent cap would remove the only signal you have that something has gone wrong.
